rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color never implies that a source, seller, or price is verified. Uncertainty must be written in words.

dos: Do keep evidence, caveats, and next questions selectable.
Do use a written explanation alongside every warning or estimate.
Do preserve text and focus when switching layouts.
donts: Don't use heavy purple, gradients, or decorative motion.
Don't imply that a plausible price is a verified transaction.
Don't hide a model failure by automatically retrying or changing models.
